title: From Algebraic Completeness to Orbit Separation: Recursive Separating Invariants for Global Neural Network Potential Energy Surfaces
title_zh: 文献研究：From Algebraic Completeness to Orbit Separation: Recursive Separating Invariants for Global Neural Network Potential Energy Surfaces
summary: Permutationally invariant polynomials (PIPs) provide a systematically improvable, symmetry-preserving representation for global potential energy surfaces (PESs), but their high computational cost as n…
abstract: arXiv:2610.21700v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Permutationally invariant polynomials (PIPs) provide a systematically improvable, symmetry-preserving representation for global potential energy surfaces (PESs), but their high computational cost as neural network descriptors limits applications to large molecular systems. Fundamental invariants (FIs), which form an algebraically complete generating set, substantially reduce the number of descriptors and enable neural network PESs for larger systems. However, PES evaluation remains computationally expensive as molecular size and complexity increase. Here, we introduce recursive separating invariants (RSIs), shifting the descriptor design principle from algebraic completeness to orbit separation. RSIs are constructed systematically through correlation order and recursion depth, providing a more computationally efficient representation. Benchmarks on reactive and nonreactive systems demonstrate that RSI-based neural network (RSI-NN) PESs achieve approximately an order-of-magnitude faster evaluation than their FI-NN counterparts, with system-dependent prediction accuracy that is comparable in several cases. These results establish orbit separation as a promising principle for developing efficient symmetry-preserving descriptors for global neural network PESs.

title: Thermodynamically Consistent Machine Learning for Fracture Prediction in Heterogeneous Materials
title_zh: 用于异质材料断裂预测的热力学一致机器学习
summary: Understanding fracture behavior is critical for assessing the structural integrity and longevity.高度耗时的基于物理的断裂模拟促进了基于机器学习的替代模型断裂演化预测的发展。然而，大多数现有的断裂预测机器学习模型都是作为黑匣子运行的，需要大量的训练数据集才能可靠地概括。在这项工作中，引入参数系统的热力学一致潜在动力学识别（tLaSDI）来预测异质材料的断裂模式和演化。
abstract: arXiv:2610.20614v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Understanding fracture behavior is critical for assessing the structural integrity and longevity. Highly time-consuming physics-based fracture simulations motivate the development of machine-learning-based fracture evolution prediction with surrogate models. However, most existing machine-learning models for fracture prediction operate as black boxes and require large training datasets to generalize reliably. In this work, Thermodynamically Consistent Latent Dynamics Identification (tLaSDI) for parametric systems is introduced to predict fracture patterns and evolution in heterogeneous materials. The model learns the thermodynamic state variable in a lower-dimensional latent space using parametric GENERIC Formalism-Informed Neural Networks (pGFINNs) that enforce key thermodynamic principles, such as total energy conservation and entropy generation. This model embeds physics into the neural network architecture using a hard-constraint method that inherently complies with the underlying thermodynamic principles. The proposed tLaSDI-pGFINNs is further enhanced by a Geometry-Conditioned Autoencoder in learning the geometry configuration for effective geometry-guided learning. The energy and entropy evolution histories demonstrate that the model preserves the thermodynamic constraints on unseen testing samples. The results further show that tLaSDI-pGFINNs can more accurately capture both fracture patterns and the subsequent fracture evolution than the purely data-driven Autoencoder Long Short-Term Memory (AE-LSTM) model.

title: SIEVE: Overcoming Topological Obstruction in Equivariant Self-Supervised Learning
title_zh: 文献研究：SIEVE: Overcoming Topological Obstruction in Equivariant Self-Supervised Learning
summary: We identify a theoretical incompatibility between 3D point cloud masked autoencoding and SE(3)-equivariant networks. We prove that standard masking triggers a topological collapse, effectively forcing…
abstract: arXiv:2610.21087v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We identify a theoretical incompatibility between 3D point cloud masked autoencoding and SE(3)-equivariant networks. We prove that standard masking triggers a topological collapse, effectively forcing the model to hallucinate orientation without a reference frame. To resolve this, we introduce SIEVE (Scalar Invariant Extraction Via Equivariance), an SE(3)-equivariant self-supervised framework that compresses point cloud geometry into invariant scalar embeddings. At its core is the spherical projection mask, which preserves global pose while obfuscating local semantics, sidestepping the obstruction by construction. Experiments confirm that SIEVE circumvents the predicted collapse where constant and noise masks fail. On downstream point cloud tasks, the resulting embeddings improve over coordinate-based baselines and hand-crafted geometric descriptors, with the largest gains on generalization to unseen shape categories.

title: Physics-guided AI reconstructs hidden patterns inside ultrathin magnets from external fields
title_zh: 物理引导的人工智能从外部磁场重建超薄磁体内部的隐藏图案
summary: 为了构建更快、更节能的计算机，研究人员需要了解纳米级磁性材料。但是，要查看这些微小的磁铁内部是令人惊讶的困难：现代显微镜只测量材料外部的磁场，而不是内部的磁场图案。由于许多不同的内部模式可以产生完全相同的场，因此向后工作长期以来一直是一个挑战。
abstract: To build faster and more energy-efficient computers, researchers need to understand nanoscale magnetic materials. But looking inside these tiny magnets is surprisingly difficult: Modern microscopes only measure the magnetic field outside the material, not the magnetic pattern inside. Because many different internal patterns can produce the exact same field, working backwards has long been a challenge.

title: Learning relaxation time distributions from spectral induced polarization data with a complex-valued variational autoencoder
title_zh: 使用复值变分自动编码器从光谱诱发偏振数据学习弛豫时间分布
summary: 光谱诱发极化 (SIP) 是一种用于表征地下材料的地球物理方法。它通过施加交流电来测量岩石和土壤的频率相关复电阻率。 Debye 和 Warburg 分解是分析和解释 SIP 数据的标准方法，因为它们可以估计岩土材料的弛豫时间分布 (RTD)。然而，传统的分解方法独立地处理测量，尽管 SIP 数据具有复值性质，但仍然在实值空间中工作，并且提供有限的不确定性量化。这些限制降低了异构数据集上传统分解的有效性。
abstract: arXiv:2603.13973v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Spectral induced polarization (SIP) is a geophysical method used to characterize subsurface materials. It measures the frequency-dependent complex electrical resistivity of rocks and soils through the application of an alternating current. Debye and Warburg decompositions are standard methods for analyzing and interpreting SIP data, as they allow estimation of the relaxation time distribution (RTD) of geomaterials. However, conventional decomposition approaches treat measurements independently, work in real-valued spaces despite the complex-valued nature of SIP data, and provide limited uncertainty quantification. These limitations reduce the effectiveness of conventional decomposition on heterogeneous datasets. We reformulate the decomposition approach as an unsupervised machine learning problem and introduce a conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) that learns a shared mapping from SIP datasets to continuous RTDs. The model is validated on a dataset comprising 140 laboratory and field SIP measurements of granular mixtures, sedimentary and igneous rock, and cementitious materials. The CVAE operates in complex-valued data space and achieves reconstruction errors of 0.53 % and 0.27 % for the imaginary and phase components of resistivity, respectively, with evidence of improvement over conventional methods at corresponding p-values of 0.007 and 0.06. The inferred RTDs are stable and physically consistent, and their total chargeability and mean relaxation time correlate with polarizable grain content and grain size, respectively, with coefficients of determination up to 0.98. An additional contribution of the proposed method is the learned latent representation, which organizes SIP spectra into a structured space. Unsupervised clustering in a two-dimensional projection of this space improves the silhouette score by nearly a factor of two relative to conventional RTD parameters.

title: Hierarchical universal open structure dataset for atomistic modeling
title_zh: 用于原子建模的分层通用开放结构数据集
summary: 机器学习模型已经改变了原子尺度的模拟，这些模型可以以量子计算的精度预测原子结构的特性，但成本却只有一小部分。由于规模和范围不断增加的合成数据集的可用性，这些模型的通用性显着增加。数据集的激增（其属性通常使用不同级别的电子结构近似来计算）是有问题的，因为不同数据集之间经常存在重叠，并且通过短分子动力学轨迹或几何优化获得的结构之间存在很强的相关性。
abstract: arXiv:2610.21771v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomic-scale simulations have been transformed by machine-learning models that predict the properties of atomistic structures with the accuracy of quantum calculations, but at a small fraction of the cost. These models have increased dramatically in generality, thanks to the availability of synthetic datasets of ever-increasing size and scope. The proliferation of datasets, with properties often computed using different levels of electronic-structure approximation, is problematic, as there is often overlap between different datasets, and strong correlations between structures obtained with short molecular dynamics trajectories or geometry optimization. To address these problems, we introduce a protocol to stratify a dataset into a hierarchy of nested subsets, subsampling from the coarsest to the finest resolution based on an "ecumetric" built to reflect the latent space representation of several popular universal machine-learning interatomic potentials. We then use this approach to combine most of the open structural datasets currently available, consolidating them into MAD-COSMO, a well-organized collection of almost 1.7 billion structures, whose 2²⁴ most diverse members form the MAD-CORE stratified coreset, which can be easily used for all sorts of tasks, from exploratory experiments to the training of foundation models at scale. We envision that this collection will guide and help coordinate future efforts, focusing them on the most relevant and/or undersampled regions of chemical and structural space, and that it will be further extended to incorporate the outcomes of the collective work of this community.

title: Altermagnetism-Induced Spin-resolved electronic structure in Janus FeX0.5Y0.5 Monolayers (X, Y = S, Se, Te)
title_zh: Janus FeX0.5Y0.5 单层中交变磁力诱导的自旋分辨电子结构（X、Y = S、Se、Te）
summary: 实现超导材料中的自旋分辨电子特性是一个关键前沿，它为无耗散自旋器件提供了新颖的基础物理和潜力。在这里，我们通过使用近藤型模型和第一性原理计算预测了一系列源自铁基超导体（例如 FeSe、FeTe 和 FeS）的 Janus FeX0.5Y0.5 单层。这些 Janus 结构表现出显着的自旋分裂电子态、大的拓扑带隙 (51.4 meV) 和高尼尔温度 (415 K)。
abstract: arXiv:2608.09054v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Realizing the spin-resolved electronic properties in superconducting materials stands as a critical frontier, offering both novel fundamental physics and potential for dissipationless spin-based devices. Here, we predict a series of Janus FeX0.5Y0.5 monolayers derived from iron-based superconductors (e.g., FeSe, FeTe, and FeS) by using Kondo-type model and first-principles calculations. These Janus structures exhibit significant spin-splittingelectronic states, large topological band gaps (51.4 meV) and high Néel temperatures (415 K). We further reveal that valley polarization can be effectively tuned via applied in-plane strain and the resulting valley-polarized anomalous Hall conductivity can be manipulated by shifting the Fermi level. Our work suggests a new strategy based on altermagnetism for engineering spin-splitting states in superconducting systems and inspires further exploration of superconducting spintronics.

title: Coexistence of Altermagnetic and Compensated Ferrimagnetic Motifs in a Noncollinear Multiferroic
title_zh: 非共线多铁性中交变磁体和补偿亚铁磁体的共存
summary: 具有非相对论性自旋分裂的共线补偿磁体包括交变磁体 (ALM) 和补偿亚铁磁体 (CFIM)，交替磁体 (ALM) 的旋转或镜像相关的相反自旋子晶格产生在 Γ 处消失的动量选择性分裂，补偿亚铁磁体 (CFIM) 的对称不等价子晶格允许在整个布里渊区（包括在 Γ 处分裂）。在这里，我们证明了多铁性硼酸石 Ni₃B₇O₁₃Cl 的共面非共线磁态在真实空间中不同的 Ni 亚晶格上承载着两个基序。
abstract: arXiv:2610.21770v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collinear compensated magnets with nonrelativistic spin splitting comprise altermagnets (ALMs), whose rotation- or mirror-related opposite-spin sublattices produce momentum-selective splitting that vanishes at Γ, and compensated ferrimagnets (CFIMs), whose symmetry-inequivalent sublattices allow splitting throughout the Brillouin zone, including at Γ. Here, we show that the coplanar noncollinear magnetic state of multiferroic boracite Ni₃B₇O₁₃Cl hosts both motifs on distinct Ni sublattices in real space. The electronic structure and spin texture exhibit coexisting d-wave-like and s-wave-like spin-polarization components associated with the ALM and CFIM motifs, respectively. Opposite ferroelectric states exhibit reversed band-resolved spin polarizations, indicating magnetoelectric coupling, and sign reversals of linear shift and circular injection currents.

title: Electronic structure and optical properties of antiferromagnetic 3d-oxides from a Wannier-localized optimally tuned screened range-separated hybrid functional
title_zh: 来自Wannier局部优化调谐筛选范围分离混合功能的反铁磁性3D氧化物的电子结构和光学性质
summary: 作者： Alexander B. Shick、Guy Ohad、Jeffrey B. Neaton和Leeor Kronik作者评估了最近开发的用于原型反铁磁绝缘体的非经验Wannier局部化、优化调谐、筛选范围分离混合（ WOT-SRSH ）功能的性能： MNO、NIO、赤铁矿和铬铁矿。通过将WOT-SRSH与已建立的混合函数、自洽准粒子GW、动态平均场理论和可用的实验数据进行比较，它们证明了其在描述基本带隙、自旋磁矩、光发射和光谱方面提供定量改进的能力。
abstract: Author(s): Alexander B. Shick, Guy Ohad, Jeffrey B. Neaton, and Leeor Kronik The authors assess the performance of the recently developed non-empirical Wannier-localized, optimally tuned, screened range-separated hybrid (WOT-SRSH) functional for prototypical antiferromagnetic insulators: MnO, NiO, hematite, and chromia. By comparing WOT-SRSH with established hybrid functionals, self-consistent quasiparticle GW, dynamical mean-field theory, and available experimental data, they demonstrate its ability to offer quantitative improvement in the description of fundamental band gaps, spin magnetic moments, photoemission, and optical spectra. These results establish WOT-SRSH as a promising framework for predictive studies of the electronic, magnetic, and optical properties of magnetic insulators. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 103804] Published Fri Oct 16, 2026

title: Theory of Dispersion and Exchange Interactions Subjected to Surface Roughness in Application to Signal Transmission through a Nanoswitch
title_zh: 受表面粗糙度影响的色散和交换相互作用理论在纳米开关信号传输中的应用
summary: 我们通过计算电弹性、色散（范德华和卡西米尔）提出了电阻纳米开关的理论描述，该纳米开关设计用于在两种操作模式之间进行转换，并且还通过考虑表面粗糙度来交换其配置中的排斥力。色散力通过 Lifshitz 理论来描述，并且在相互作用物体之间的最短距离处（该理论不适用），通过原子间势的加性求和方法来描述，该方法针对非加和性效应的作用进行了校正。交换排斥也可以通过原子间势的求和并使用邻近力近似来找到。
abstract: arXiv:2610.21652v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the theoretical description of a resistive nanoswitch designated for a change-over between the two operation modes by calculating the electri elastic, dispersion (van der Waals and Casimir), and also exchange repulsive forces in its configuration with an account of surface roughness. The dispersion forces are described by means of the Lifshitz theory and, at the shortest separations between the interacting bodies, where this theory is inapplicable, by the method of additive summation of the interatomic potentials corrected for the role of the effects of nonadditivity. The exchange repulsion is also found by a summation of the interatomic potentials and using the proximity force approximation. It is shown that the nanoswitch possesses the equilibrium closest separation between a cantilever tip and a ground plate calculated as a function of the actuation voltage and operates in a cyclic manner with no pull-in when this voltage is switched on and off. We have found the tunnel current between a cantilever tip and a plate and investigated distortions appearing in the signal transmitted through a nanoswitch. According to our results, the amplitude distortions arising in the low-frequency information signal can be made sufficiently small by increasing a difference between the amplitudes of the carrier and information signals. Possible applications of the obtained results are discussed.

title: Interlocked Vortex Order in the Frustrated A₃V₉Te₁₃ Lattice (A=Cs,Rb)
title_zh: 受抑 A₃V₉Te₁₃ 晶格中的互锁涡序 (A=Cs,Rb)
summary: 最近合成的 A₃V₉Te₁₃（A = Cs，Rb）提供了一个独特的平台，用于探索传统 Kagome 系统之外的几何挫败、磁性和相关电子态之间的相互作用。基于第一性原理计算，我们证明了受挫 V 子晶格自然地稳定了鲁棒涡旋或反涡旋反铁磁基态，其总能量远低于所有其他配置。此外，海森堡模型分析显示对基态磁构型的强烈约束，使得1个三角形的固定自旋构型传播并固定所有其他三角形。涡旋或反涡旋相的电子结构让人想起戈薇金属，包括狄拉克式能带交叉、范霍夫奇点和费米能级附近的平带。
abstract: arXiv:2610.21854v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently synthesized A₃V₉Te₁₃ (A = Cs, Rb) provides a unique platform for exploring the interplay between geometric frustration, magnetism, and correlated electronic states beyond conventional kagome systems. Based on first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that the frustrated V sublattice naturally stabilizes a robust vortex or anti-vortex antiferromagnetic ground state, whose total energy is substantially lower than all other configurations. In addition, the Heisenberg model analysis show strong constraints on the ground state magnetic configuration, such that fixing spin configuration of 1 triangle propagates and fixes all others. The vortex or anti-vortex phase hosts electronic structures reminiscent of kagome metals, including Dirac-like band crossings, van Hove singularities, and flat bands near the Fermi level. Owing to the noncollinear spin texture and quasi-two-dimensional magnetic character, the Néel temperature exhibits an extremely weak dependence on both the magnitude and direction of external magnetic fields, consistent with experimental observations. For Cs-based compound, the ground state band structure is metallic with 6 Weyl points in the BZ; while for the Rb-based compound, spin--orbit coupling opens an approximately 27-meV gap at ambient pressure due to the lifted C₃ symmetry. Our results establish A₃V₉Te₁₃ as a promising platform for studying frustration-driven chiral magnetism and its interplay with topological electronic states.

title: Simulating cavity QED with spin-orbit coupled Bose-Einstein condensates revisited
title_zh: 重新审视自旋轨道耦合玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态模拟腔 QED
summary: 在合成平台中模拟空腔量子电动力学提供了一种在没有真实光子的情况下研究光物质物理的途径。我们重新评估了调和俘获、自旋轨道耦合原子与量子拉比和迪克模型之间经常被引用的类比，特别强调挤压和纠缠。单个非相互作用原子精确地实现量子拉比哈密顿量，直至基本自旋和相空间旋转。然而，对于 N 个不相互作用的原子，质心模态只是包含 N-1 个相对模态的完整正交集的一个成员。我们证明，在包含所有模式后，集体模式生成的自旋项与相对模式生成的自旋项完全抵消。
abstract: arXiv:2603.28368v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Simulating cavity quantum electrodynamics in synthetic platforms offers a route to studying light--matter physics without real photons. We reassess the frequently invoked analogy between harmonically trapped, spin--orbit-coupled atoms and the quantum Rabi and Dicke models, with particular emphasis on squeezing and entanglement. A single non-interacting atom realizes the quantum Rabi Hamiltonian exactly, up to elementary spin and phase-space rotations. For N non-interacting atoms, however, the center-of-mass mode is only one member of a complete orthonormal set containing N-1 relative modes. We prove that, after all modes are included, the spin--spin terms generated by the collective mode cancel exactly against those generated by the relative modes. Equivalently, the original Hamiltonian is a sum of independent one-particle Hamiltonians and therefore cannot create interparticle entanglement from a separable state. Contact interactions invalidate this cancellation but do not remove the relative modes or turn the exact many-body Hamiltonian into a Dicke model. A one-mode Dicke description can arise only as a controlled low-energy approximation after all relevant relative excitations have been shown to be spectrally suppressed. We discuss this distinction together with experimental scales, finite temperature, and possible mode-selection strategies. We also distinguish the single-particle interference underlying density fringes from the interaction-stabilized stripe supersolid observed in many-body condensates.

title: The bulk spectral gap is certifiable from above but uncomputable from below
title_zh: 体光谱间隙可以从上方证明，但从下方无法计算
summary: 确定热力学极限中的光谱间隙是量子多体物理学的一个核心挑战。当施加固定边界条件时，这个问题是不可判定的：即使有无限的资源，也没有算法可以决定每个哈密顿量是否有间隙。然而，热力学极限旨在捕捉非常大系统的内在特性，这不应该取决于如何选择它们的边界。因此，在这里，我们考虑体光谱间隙问题，该问题仅涉及无限系统的固有激发，与任何边界无关。我们首先给出一个通用算法，产生一个关于体块间隙的经过认证的上限层次结构，以更多计算为代价任意紧。
abstract: arXiv:2606.03836v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Determining spectral gaps in the thermodynamic limit is a central challenge in quantum many-body physics. When a fixed boundary condition is imposed, this problem is undecidable: no algorithm, even with unlimited resources, can decide for every Hamiltonian whether it is gapped. Yet the thermodynamic limit is meant to capture the intrinsic properties of very large systems, which should not depend on how their boundaries are chosen. Here, we therefore consider the bulk spectral gap problem, which concerns only the intrinsic excitations of the infinite system, independently of any boundary. We first give a general algorithm producing a hierarchy of certified upper bounds on the bulk gap, arbitrarily tight at the cost of more computation. Second, we prove that the spectral gap problem remains undecidable in the bulk: no algorithm can decide whether the bulk gap is positive, already for translationally invariant nearest-neighbour chains of fixed local dimension. The bulk spectral gap is thus certifiable from above but uncomputable from below. More precisely, the bulk-gaplessness promise problem is RE-complete, exactly as hard as the halting problem. The same construction also shows that deciding whether an explicitly given state is a ground state of the infinite system is undecidable. Finally, we apply the upper-bounding algorithm to the spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet to produce the first nontrivial certified upper bounds on its bulk gap.

title: The Magic Barrier: A Universal Feature of Quantum Thermalization
title_zh: 魔障：量子热化的普遍特征
summary: 我们证明，“魔障”的出现是量子遍历理论中热化的普遍特征，其特征是在快速纠缠增长过程中瞬时最大非稳定性，它与随机矩阵光谱特性密切相关。从纯乘积态开始，我们分析确定了由从所有三个高斯系综中抽取的随机矩阵哈密顿量生成的酉动力学下纠缠熵、反平坦性、纠缠能力和非局部迹距离魔法的时间演化。我们发现反平坦性、纠缠能力和非局部魔力的瞬态最大值与纠缠增长的最大速率发生在相同的特征时间尺度上。这些结果表明，魔障是 RMT 热化的普遍特征，表明量子混沌系统的普遍性。
abstract: arXiv:2610.20768v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show that the emergence of a ``magic barrier'', characterized by a transient maximum of nonstabilizerness during rapid entanglement growth, is a universal feature of thermalization within quantum ergodic theories, which is intimately connected to random matrix spectral properties. Starting from a pure product state, we analytically determine the time evolution of entanglement entropy, antiflatness, capacity of entanglement, and nonlocal trace distance magic under unitary dynamics generated by random matrix Hamiltonians drawn from all three Gaussian ensembles. We find that the transient maxima of antiflatness, capacity of entanglement, and nonlocal magic occur on the same characteristic timescale as the maximum rate of entanglement growth. These results establish that the magic barrier is a universal feature of RMT thermalization, suggesting universality across quantum chaotic systems. We conclude that quantitative simulations of thermalization in ergodic quantum theories inherently require quantum computation.

title: Thermodynamic-limit bootstrap: Solving fractional quantum Hall ground states
title_zh: 热力学极限自举：求解分数量子霍尔基态
summary: 强相互作用的基态通常在有限系统中计算，然后外推到热力学极限（TDL）。在这里，我们开发了一种量子多体自举程序，可以直接在 TDL 中求解分数量子霍尔基态。该方法给出了严格且定量严格的基态能量下界，并确定了基态结构和拓扑顺序。对于劳克林和普法夫父哈密顿量，它几乎逐层再现了精确的配对相关函数和低位轨道纠缠谱（OES）。
abstract: arXiv:2610.21317v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strongly interacting ground states are usually computed in finite systems and then extrapolated to the thermodynamic limit (TDL). Here we develop a quantum many-body bootstrap that solves fractional quantum Hall ground states directly in the TDL. The method gives rigorous and quantitatively tight lower bounds on the ground-state energy and identifies the ground-state structure and topological order. For Laughlin and Pfaffian parent Hamiltonians, it reproduces exact pair-correlation functions and low-lying orbital entanglement spectrum (OES) nearly level by level. For Coulomb interactions, the rigorous TDL energy bounds closely match thermodynamic estimates from exact diagonalization and density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) extrapolations, and the local diagnostics recover established Laughlin and Moore--Read OES counting and Friedel oscillations of the composite Fermi liquid. Beyond these benchmarks, the bootstrap resolves the thermodynamic ground states at ν=1/4 and ν=12/5, identifying a composite Fermi liquid and overlineRR₃ topological order, respectively. The same framework applies equally well to Abelian and non-Abelian, gapped and gapless quantum Hall states. The TDL bootstrap therefore provides a general ground-state solver that determines both the energy and the state directly in the TDL.

title: A closed system setting for quantum thermalisation in free fermions
title_zh: 自由费米子量子热化的封闭系统设置
summary: 我们研究热化作用以及在封闭量子环境中可能发生的姆彭巴效应，该环境模拟系统与仅在其边界耦合的热储层的相互作用。具体来说，我们考虑一种三方几何结构，其中最初在有限温度下制备的有限链突然在两侧连接到在不同温度下保持的相同性质的两条半无限链。这些外链充当热浴，而整个系统在齐次哈密顿量下统一演化。该设置提供了温度猝灭的简单量子实现，并且与首次观察到经典 Mpemba 效应的原始场景非常相似。
abstract: arXiv:2606.06362v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study thermalisation and the possible occurrence of the Mpemba effect in a closed quantum setting that mimics the interaction of a system with thermal reservoirs coupled only at its boundaries. Specifically, we consider a tripartite geometry in which a finite chain, initially prepared at a finite temperature, is suddenly connected on both sides to two semi-infinite chains of the same nature held at a different temperature. These outer chains act as thermal baths, while the full system evolves unitarily under a homogeneous Hamiltonian. This setup provides a simple quantum realisation of a temperature quench and closely resembles the original scenario in which the classical Mpemba effect was first observed. We focus on two paradigmatic free-fermion models, the XX chain and the transverse-field Ising chain, which respectively preserve and break the global U(1) particle-number symmetry. As a probe of relaxation, we consider the Frobenius distance between the time-evolved reduced density matrix of the central subsystem and its stationary state, which is the thermal state at the bath temperature. Exploiting the free-fermionic structure of both models, the dynamics remains Gaussian and the Frobenius distance can be expressed exactly in terms of two-point correlation functions. Combining this representation with generalised hydrodynamics, we derive analytical predictions for the Frobenius distance in the hydrodynamic limit, providing a complete characterisation of the thermalisation process. Using these results, we investigate the possible occurrence of the Mpemba effect. We find that, despite the genuine non-equilibrium dynamics displayed by the system, no Mpemba effect arises in this setting. Our analysis identifies a broad class of boundary-driven thermalisation protocols in which relaxation is fully characterised analytically and exhibits no anomalous acceleration of equilibration.

title: Calculating strongly correlated ground states from the non-Markovian dissipative dynamics of Gaussian fermions
title_zh: 从高斯费米子的非马尔可夫耗散动力学计算强相关基态
summary: 我们引入了相互作用的费米子哈密顿量的基态与纯耗散开放量子系统的非平衡稳态之间的映射。在第三量子化的框架内，我们将费米-哈伯德哈密顿量映射到作用于马约拉纳费米子的 Lindblad 跳跃算子。值得注意的是，跳跃和相互作用项都映射到跳跃算子上，这些算子保留了沿着各个量子轨迹的马约拉纳费米子的高斯性。因此，可以仅使用两点相关函数来阐明动力学，并且可以有效地模拟每个轨迹，并且计算成本与系统规模呈多项式缩放。我们进一步表明，有限的粒子数需要负耗散率，从而导致本质上的非马尔可夫动力学。
abstract: arXiv:2607.06293v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce a mapping between the ground state of interacting fermionic Hamiltonians and the non-equilibrium steady state of a purely dissipative open quantum system. Within the framework of third quantization, we map the Fermi-Hubbard Hamiltonian onto Lindblad jump operators acting on Majorana fermions. Remarkably, both hopping and interaction terms map onto jump operators that preserve the Gaussianity of Majorana fermions along individual quantum trajectories. As a result, the dynamics can be unravelled and each trajectory can be simulated efficiently using only two-point correlation functions, with a computational cost that scales polynomially with system size. We further show that finite particle number requires negative dissipative rates, leading to an intrinsically non-Markovian dynamics. The corresponding trajectory unravelling involves both positive and negative stochastic weights and exhibits a sign problem and large fluctuations, so that convergence requires an exponentially large number of trajectories. The overall computational cost remains exponential in system size despite the efficient Gaussian representation of individual trajectories, but is crucially dependent on the computational complexity of the non-Markovian unravelling, motivating further studies on the efficiency of such unravellings.

title: Flat-band ferrimagnetism in the edge-centered honeycomb antiferromagnet: From harmonic flat magnon to broad continuum
title_zh: 边缘中心蜂窝反铁磁体中的平带亚铁磁性：从谐波平面磁振子到宽连续谱
summary: 平带最引人注目的方面之一不仅仅是它缺乏色散，而且它将单粒子动能降低到非常小的尺度，使相互作用效应成为低能物理中的主要能量尺度。这张图支撑了平带铁磁性、平带超导性和局域磁振子等概念。然而，一个更根本的问题仍然存在。平带属于单粒子或线性自旋波物理学的语言；它们是否作为受保护的锐激发存在于真正的多体量子磁体中，或者仅仅提供非相互作用图像留下的光谱权重骨架，目前仍不清楚。我们研究边缘中心蜂窝晶格上的自旋 1/2 海森堡反铁磁体来研究这个问题。
abstract: arXiv:2610.21580v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: One of the most striking aspects of a flat band is not merely its lack of dispersion, but that it reduces the single-particle kinetic energy to a very small scale, allowing interaction effects to become the dominant energy scale in the low-energy physics. This picture has underpinned concepts such as flat-band ferromagnetism, flat-band superconductivity, and localized magnons. A more fundamental question, however, remains. Flat bands belong to the language of single-particle or linear-spin-wave physics; whether they survive as protected sharp excitations in a genuine many-body quantum magnet, or merely provide a skeleton of spectral weight left by the noninteracting picture, remains unclear. We study the spin-1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnet on the edge-centered honeycomb lattice to examine this question. In contrast to flat bands in geometrically frustrated magnets such as kagome, this lattice has a 2:3 sublattice imbalance that renders the intersublattice coupling matrix rectangular, whose null space gives rise to a flat band at the single-particle level. The same imbalance stabilizes a ferrimagnetic ground state through the Lieb--Mattis theorem and leads to an edge-site-localized flat magnon in linear spin-wave theory. Combining linear spin-wave theory, sign-problem-free stochastic series expansion quantum Monte Carlo, and stochastic analytic continuation, we find that quantum fluctuations transform this harmonic flat mode into a broad continuum whose centroid is about 1.55J and nearly dispersionless along the high-symmetry path. Sublattice imbalance thus offers an unfrustrated route that unifies flat bands and ferrimagnetism, and suggests that flat-band geometry organizes many-body spectral weight rather than giving rise to a protected quasiparticle.

title: From picometre displacements to a three-dimensional lattice gas of polar skyrmions
title_zh: 文献研究：From picometre displacements to a three-dimensional lattice gas of polar skyrmions
summary: Polar skyrmions, the electric analogues of magnetic skyrmions, form arrays in PbTiO3/SrTiO3 superlattices that are known to be only short-range ordered, but how this disordered ensemble is organized i…
abstract: arXiv:2610.22309v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Polar skyrmions, the electric analogues of magnetic skyrmions, form arrays in PbTiO3/SrTiO3 superlattices that are known to be only short-range ordered, but how this disordered ensemble is organized in three dimensions, and how its microscopic structure underlies this organization, have remained largely inaccessible. Here, using three-dimensional difference pair distribution function (3D-ΔPDF) analysis of X-ray diffuse scattering, we show that the polar skyrmion bubbles form a three-dimensional lattice gas: they occupy discrete sites, but their order extends over only a few neighbours and is two to three times stronger across the SrTiO3 spacers than within a layer. This interlayer coupling is consistent with the polarization of the bubbles extending into the spacers. Within each bubble, the polarization rotates in a predominantly Néel-type manner, and Pb and Ti rotate together with comparable picometre displacements, demonstrating that both A- and B-site cations take part in the polar distortion.

title: Indirect Control of Buried CoB Spin Textures via C₆₀-Induced Modification of Ir Spin-Orbit Coupling
title_zh: 通过 C₆₀ 诱导的 Ir 自旋轨道耦合修改间接控制埋置 CoB 自旋纹理
summary: 了解有机材料如何调节磁性结构是有机自旋电子学的一个核心挑战。在这里，我们证明了 C₆₀ 分子薄膜对基于 Pt/CoB/Ir 的多层系统中的埋藏磁自旋织构产生了显着且可量化的影响，该系统具有界面 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用（iDMI）。使用洛伦兹透射电子显微镜，测量无场和原位场环境中的磁畴行为。在菲涅尔模式下，我们揭示了 C₆₀ 沉积时磁畴周期性的减少。
abstract: arXiv:2610.21704v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how organic materials modulate magnetic structure is a central challenge in organic spintronics. Here, we demonstrate that C₆₀ molecular films exert a pronounced and quantifiable influence on the buried magnetic spin texture in Pt/CoB/Ir based multilayer systems hosting interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (iDMI). Using Lorentz transmission electron microscopy, the magnetic domain behaviour in field-free and in-situ field environments is measured. In Fresnel mode, we reveal a reduction in magnetic domain periodicity upon C₆₀ deposition. Then, using pixelated 4D-STEM differential phase contrast mode, we establish that this modification arises from a substantial enhancement of effective magnetic anisotropy and interfacial DMI strength. Coupled with bulk magnetometry and micromagnetic simulations, we propose a mechanism based on spin-orbit coupling at the C₆₀/Ir interface which modifies the iDMI and drives a contraction of spin texture density throughout the multilayer stack. These findings extend the impact of organic molecular capping films as effective and accessible routes for engineering spin textures to buried magnetic multilayer systems, with direct implications for the design of next-generation spintronic and neuromorphic devices.
